package normalization_adapter

import (
    "bytes"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "math"
    "os"
    "strconv"
    "testing"
)

type corpusCase struct {
    Branch string `json:"branch"`
    Input string `json:"input"`
    Bits string `json:"bits"`
    ArrayBits []*string `json:"array_bits"`
    Value json.RawMessage `json:"value"`
    Error string `json:"error"`
}

func TestCorpus(t *testing.T) {
    normalizer, err := New()
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    data, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    var cases []corpusCase
    if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    for index, entry := range cases {
        t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%d", index), func(t *testing.T) {
            output, err := normalizer.Normalize(entry.Branch, []byte(entry.Input))
            if entry.Error != "" {
                refusal, ok := err.(Refused)
                if !ok || len(refusal) == 0 || refusal[0].Rule != entry.Error { t.Fatalf("%s: %v", entry.Input, err) }
                return
            }
            if err != nil { t.Fatalf("%s: %v", entry.Input, err) }
            if entry.Bits != "" {
                expected, err := strconv.ParseUint(entry.Bits, 16, 64)
                if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(string(output), 64)
                if err != nil || math.Float64bits(value) != expected { t.Fatalf("%s: %s bits %x want %x", entry.Input, output, math.Float64bits(value), expected) }
                if !bytes.ContainsAny(output, ".eE") { t.Fatalf("floating lexical identity: %s", output) }
                if expected == 1<<63 && string(output) != "-0.0" { t.Fatalf("negative zero: %s", output) }
                roundtrip, err := normalizer.Normalize("scalar", output)
                if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                value, err = strconv.ParseFloat(string(roundtrip), 64)
                if err != nil || math.Float64bits(value) != expected { t.Fatal("round-trip changed bits") }
            } else if entry.ArrayBits != nil {
                var values []json.RawMessage
                if err := json.Unmarshal(output, &values); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                if len(values) != len(entry.ArrayBits) { t.Fatal("array length") }
                for index, bits := range entry.ArrayBits {
                    if bits == nil { if string(values[index]) != "null" { t.Fatal("nullable item") }; continue }
                    expected, _ := strconv.ParseUint(*bits, 16, 64)
                    value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(string(values[index]), 64)
                    if err != nil || math.Float64bits(value) != expected { t.Fatal("array item bits") }
                }
            } else {
                var actual, expected bytes.Buffer
                if err := json.Compact(&actual, output); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                if err := json.Compact(&expected, entry.Value); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
                if actual.String() != expected.String() { t.Fatalf("%s: %s want %s", entry.Input, output, entry.Value) }
            }
        })
    }
}

func TestRetainedDocumentBoundary(t *testing.T) {
    normalizer, err := New()
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    value, err := normalizer.NormalizeBase64JSON("scalar", "LTA=")
    if err != nil || string(value) != "-0.0" { t.Fatalf("%s: %v", value, err) }
}
